find:
<xf:foreach loop="$pages" value="$page">
						<xf:datarow
							label="{$page.title}"
							hint="{$page.page_name}"
							href="{{ link('help-pages/edit', $page) }}"
							explain="{$page.description}"
							delete="{{ link('help-pages/delete', $page) }}"
							hash="{$page.page_id}">
							<xf:toggle name="active[{$page.page_id}]" selected="$page.active"
								class="dataList-cell--separated" submit="true"
								tooltip="{{ phrase('enable_disable_x', {'title': $page.title}) }}" />
						</xf:datarow>
					</xf:foreach>
replace:
<xf:foreach loop="$groupedPages" value="$group">
    <xf:if is="$group.category">
        <xf:datarow rowtype="subsection"
					label="{$group.category.title}"
					explain="{{ !$group.category.active ? phrase('sylphian_help_category_disabled_explain') : '' }}"
					href="{{ link('help-pages/category-edit', null, {'category_id': $group.category.category_id}) }}"
            		delete="{{ link('help-pages/category-delete', null, {'category_id': $group.category.category_id}) }}">
            <xf:toggle
                name="category_active[{$group.category.category_id}]"
                selected="$group.category.active"
                class="dataList-cell--separated"
                submit="true"
                tooltip="{{ phrase('enable_disable_x', {'title': $group.category.title}) }}"
            />
        </xf:datarow>
    <xf:else />
        <xf:datarow rowtype="subsection">
            <xf:cell colspan="3">
                {{ phrase('sylphian_help_uncategorised') }}
            </xf:cell>
        </xf:datarow>
    </xf:if>

    <xf:foreach loop="$group.pages" value="$page">
        <xf:datarow
            rowclass="{{ ($group.category AND !$group.category.active) ? 'dataList-row--disabled' : '' }}"
            label="{$page.title}"
            hint="{$page.page_name}"
            href="{{ link('help-pages/edit', $page) }}"
            explain="{$page.description}"
            delete="{{ link('help-pages/delete', $page) }}"
            hash="{$page.page_id}"
        >
            <xf:toggle
                name="active[{$page.page_id}]"
                selected="$page.active"
                class="dataList-cell--separated"
                submit="true"
                tooltip="{{ phrase('enable_disable_x', {'title': $page.title}) }}"
            />
        </xf:datarow>
    </xf:foreach>
</xf:foreach>
